extracted.intended_audience: scientists, engineers, and general Nature readers interested in metallurgy, public health, optics, and observational astronomy
extracted.subtask_description: Reading or peer-reviewing a research article (and adjacent reports/notes) reporting experimental observations and interpretations about the hard and soft states in ductile metals, with supporting microscopic, thermal, and mechanical evidence. The page also contains related short reports on hygiene, serum treatment, meteors, and scientific commentary.
